problems: Parents reported difficulty explaining printed module lessons to their children.
Teachers questioned whether modular learning helps learners understand lessons.
Survey responses identified landforms, rocks, and minerals as difficult Science topics.
Physical rock and mineral samples may be limited for classroom demonstrations.
objectives: Provide short Science lessons before each level to support explanations during home study.
Implement interactive exploration and end-of-level reviews to supplement printed Science modules.
Develop four episodes covering Mountains, Hills, Plains, and Plateaus, including selected rock and mineral topics.
Present digital illustrations of selected rocks and minerals with names and short descriptions.

openings.Project Context: This section explains the background and learning concerns that guide the development of Land Grand. It begins with educational technology worldwide, then discusses home learning in the Philippines and the needs reported at Baluan Elementary School.
openings.Purpose and Description of the Project: This section explains the purpose of Land Grand and describes its main learning activities. It shows how the proposed game would support Grade 5 learners alongside printed learning materials.
openings.Objectives of the Project: This section presents the general and specific objectives of Land Grand. The specific objectives follow the same order as the project concerns and describe features that can be built and checked.
openings.Scope and Limitations of the Project: This section describes the coverage and boundaries of the Land Grand project. It explains what the game includes and the limits of its use and the survey findings.
openings.Scope: This section outlines the learners, content, game activities, and technical requirements included in Land Grand. Project completion is planned for November–December 2026.
openings.Limitations: This section explains the limits of the game and how the survey findings should be understood. It identifies the boundaries of the project's learners, content, and offline use.
